test-project-uuid-001.Purpose & context: Building a document processing pipeline that uses LLMs to extract structured data from PDFs. The system needs to handle high volume (1000+ docs/day) with 99% accuracy.
test-project-uuid-001.Current state: MVP complete with basic extraction working. Currently optimizing for speed and adding support for multi-page documents.
test-project-uuid-001.Key learnings & principles: Chunking documents before LLM processing is essential. Smaller focused prompts work better than large complex ones. Always verify LLM output against source.

test-project-uuid-002.Purpose & context: Home automation project using Home Assistant and custom Python scripts. Goal is to automate lighting, heating, and security based on presence detection.
test-project-uuid-002.Current state: Basic setup complete. Motion sensors and smart lights working. Need to integrate with heating system.
test-project-uuid-002.Approach & patterns: Prefer local processing over cloud dependencies. Use MQTT for device communication. Keep automations simple and debuggable.
